budget_counter_static_proof.hostReadBytes_mutations: GasBudgetRuntime.cuh:77 increments only inside gasBudgetDetail::read; configureGasBudget can copy prior counters, but the fixture never calls it.
budget_counter_static_proof.owner_partition_independence: Each owner/reference pair explicitly prepares one request and commits one requested interval. Trial begin/commit/rollback use snapshot/reset only; captureChemistryAudit is a no-op. Thus failed or accepted substep counts cannot change hostReadBytes.
budget_counter_static_proof.byte_calculation: nCells=2, Ns=2: one inventory reads V[2], rho[2], rhoE[2], species[4] = 80 bytes; commit additionally reads transport[8] and chemistrySpecies[4], so prepare+commit = 80 + (80+64+32) = 256 bytes.
budget_counter_static_proof.deviceBytes: Default 0 in GasBudgetHostLedger; fixture uses testMem and never configureGasBudget, which contains the sole allocation assignment. Serialized audit_device_bytes already compared by prior semanticLedger adds fixed 96 snapshot bytes.
